patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with content often centered, alternating between deep black and white backgrounds to create high contrast visual breaks.
Prominent use of oversized, bold sans-serif typography for section headings and key statements, often in white or the accent orange against dark backgrounds.
A highly restricted, high-contrast palette dominated by deep black, pure white, and a single vibrant orange (#f36000) as the primary accent color.
A persistent, sticky top navigation bar with a solid orange background remains visible and fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Large, full-width text blocks with minimal imagery serve as primary content sections, delivering key messages with impactful typography and stark contrast.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that maintains its full height and vibrant orange background as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to primary links.
Content sections are revealed through standard vertical scrolling, with no complex scroll-triggered animations like fade-ins or parallax effects observed for individual elements.

Visual impact is achieved through stark color contrast, primarily white or orange text on deep black backgrounds, and oversized typography for key messages, rather than relying on complex graphics or imagery.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy, creating a strong hierarchical contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within large text blocks, contributing to a sense of gravitas and clarity.

standout: The design's distinctiveness lies in its extreme high-contrast aesthetic, leveraging deep black backgrounds with a single vibrant orange accent and oversized, bold typography to create a powerful, almost stark, visual statement. It prioritizes impactful text over imagery in many sections, giving it a very direct and authoritative feel.
